abstract_evidence_excerpt: Microaeration can be used to cost-effectively remove in-situ H2S from the biogas generated in anaerobic digesters. This study is aimed at developing and validating an extension of the Anaerobic Digestion Model n°1 capable of incorporating the main phenomena which occurs during microaeration.
